qualification: Full proof for expanding-square uniform initialization, including ties. The arXiv source does not specify this sampling law; this does not establish a distribution-independent refutation. Prior mathematical argument due to Shivam Patel (2026-08-20).
title: Square-uniform Fibonacci minimum probability
outcome: In the explicit expanding-square uniform initialization model, both strict and tie-inclusive minimum-at-zero probabilities converge to5/24, not1/4. The original source leaves the sampling law unspecified.
novelty: Formal verification of Patel’s existing5/24 argument for an explicit interpretation; no distribution-independent resolution or worldwide novelty claim.
